🚀 client | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: A desktop application for developers to interact with and test various network protocols (HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) locally and efficiently.
✨ Key Features: • Support for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket protocols • Local-first architecture with SQLite database for offline functionality • Collections, environments, history, and scripting capabilities • Postman v2.1 import/export • Optional real-time cloud sync
📖 Summary: Tetiva is a desktop API client for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket, built with Go and Vue. It offers a local-first, offline-capable experience with optional cloud sync, providing a fast and private alternative to existing tools.
